Method of Attack: Exploited zero-day vulnerability (BATM-4780) to remotely upload a Java application via ATM's master service interface and run it with 'batm' user privileges
Access database, read and decrypt API keys, send funds from hot wallets, download usernames and password hashes, disable 2FA, access terminal event logs, and scan for private keys scanned at ATM
Impacted Systems: Other GB ATM operators' standalone servers
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in BATM management platform
Scanning Digital Ocean cloud hosting IP address space to identify running CAS services on port 7741
Indicators of Compromise: Uploaded malicious Java applications appearing as random-named .war and .war.deployed files in /batm/app/admin/standalone/deployments/
Cryptocurrency addresses used by attacker including Bitcoin address receiving 56.28570959 BTC and Ethereum address receiving 21.79436191 ETH
Suspicious gaps in master.log and admin.log files due to attacker deleting log entries
